references.text: The first census of the descendants of Ephraim, which provides the basis for the genealogies mentioned in chapter 26.
Ephraim is mentioned as a son of Joseph and gives rise to the tribe of Ephraim.
Jacob blesses Ephraim and Manasseh, where Ephraim receives the greater blessing and becomes the ancestor of one of the tribes of Israel.
Shuthelah is mentioned as a son of Ephraim in the genealogical records of Chronicles, confirming the lineage.
The tribal inheritance of Ephraim in Canaan, showing the tribe's territory after the settlement.
